file_id: In Reference vs Chain Singh on 6 January, 2026

sentences.text:
In Reference vs Chain Singh on 6 January, 2026
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Crr No. 2195 of 2025
(In Reference Vs Chain Singh And Others ) Dated : 06-01-2026 Shri Rajendra Singh
Yadav - Public Prosecutor for the State.
This criminal revision has been registered suo motu on a letter by learned Second Additional
Sessions Judge, Ganjbasoda, Distt. Vidisha, to the effect that due to mistake he had awarded seven
years imprisonment to the accused under Section 376 of Ipc as he was not aware about the
amendment of 2018 whereby minimum imprisonment prescribed is 10 years.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Earlier this matter was pending before the Principal Seat Jabalpur, but on account of Criminal Appeal No.6254/2025 pending before this Bench, present revision has been transferred to this Bench for analogous hearing.
In the present revision, no one is appearing on behalf of the accused- Chain Singh.
Shri Devansh Mishra, learned counsel, who is appearing on behalf of accused Chain Singh in connected Criminal Appeal, prays for time to seek instructions in the matter.

(PUSHPENDRA YADAV) JUDGE ms/-
